note: Paper trades only: no money is placed. Rules fixed on 20 Nov 2026 and never changed afterwards; entry is the first NSE close after the news reached readers, exit the close 'hold' sessions later, net of 0.3% round-trip costs. Educational; not investment advice.

strategies.name: Buy the fall
strategies.rule: PulsEdge flags bad news on a stock (an AI call pointing down) and the stock has already fallen 3% or more from the close before the news to the first close after it reached readers: buy at that close, sell at the next close.
strategies.earlier: 9-19 Nov replay: 24 trades, 58% won, +0.42% a trade after costs (8 of them on 18 Nov; not proven)
